name: Path to Ascension: a claimed tracking tutorial counts its quest as done (#8833)
contract: Tutorial 56 (Tutorial.dbc: achievement 87246, quest 1903520 'Path to Ascension: Rank Up Your Spells', level 8) is a tracking tutorial. The client (UIParent.lua PLAYER_LEVEL_UP) offers 1903520 as an auto-quest pop-up at level 11 (AUTO_QUEST_RANK_UP_SPELLS_LEVEL) unless C_Quest:HasOrHasDoneQuest finds it in the log, in GetQuestsCompleted() or already popped.

GetQuestsCompleted() is filled by SMSG_QUERY_QUESTS_COMPLETED_RESPONSE, which lists rewarded quests only. PathToAscensionRewards Claim() records the claim in core.ascension.tutorial_rewards but never marks 1903520 rewarded, so a claimed tutorial keeps its pop-up, and accepting it is refused as already collected (#6079 path).

Expected: claiming tutorial 56 pays the reward and marks 1903520 rewarded, so the completed-quest query reports it and the client stops offering it. A character that claimed it earlier gets the rewarded mark at its next login.
The pop-up itself is client-side and remains an in-game check.

steps.label: Let login rewards and the tutorial state settle
CONTROL: an unclaimed tutorial leaves its quest open
DISCRIMINATING: the tracking quest counts as rewarded
SETUP: the veteran claimed tutorial 56 before the fix
SETUP: the earlier claim left the quest open
DISCRIMINATING: login records the claimed tracking quest as rewarded
